author: Arachadonic
body:
As it stands, when your team wins a game in any of the modes I have played you do not seem to gain any experience. I feel like this is a pretty obvious thing that is missing from the server as without a reward of some sort for winning then like there really isn't a point in trying to win.

As for the amount of exp you should get I am unsure. It depends per game-mode and we don't want to ruin the economy. I know the exp gain for default users is low as an extra incentive to buy a donor rank and prehaps to make the game more challenging but we really do get next to nothing for a kill so getting like 4-10 exp for a win which we worked for would be nice.

That's it really. This was probably suggested before but no harm in bringing it back up. Feel free to share opinions below. 
Thanks!

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body: If someone logs on, joins a Nebula game, and stays AFK for the entire rotation, while his or her team wins every time, that person does not deserve XP even though he won. Also, donors could just switch teams in Nexus at the end of a match to get the experience. If you actually work to try and win, then you deserve XP. That's why you gain XP for breaking monuments in Nebula and for killing people in Nexus.

replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
Let me break it down:

CTH: Requires a whole team effort to win. If a player is afk, their chances of winning are extremely, EXTREMELY slim. 

Nebula: To join a game, you have to use /join to join a team. If they went afk, they couldn't do that. 

Nexus: TDM. Basically what I said on CTH. 

Although regardless, you should earn exp for winning, getting objectives, etc.

So yeah +1
